name: EvalCrafter
description: EvalCrafter is a benchmark and evaluation framework for large video generation models. It includes a diverse set of 700 prompts for text-to-video generation and evaluates models on visual, content, motion qualities, and text-video alignment using 17 objective metrics aligned with human opinions.
reputation: A well-known benchmark/framework in video generation evaluation that is frequently cited for combining human-aligned assessment with multiple objective metrics.
notes: Uses a large prompt set and multiple objective metrics combined via a learned alignment to human opinions.
